description: Read the live Heat: heat holds tokens screened by Trnch and ranked by Heat score; new holds just-spotted tokens not yet screened (higher risk). Each token is an opaque id with rank, Heat score, price, liquidity, volume, price changes and entry time. Returns nextSince: pass it back as since to get only new entries, and dedupe by id. The feed refreshes every few seconds. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

since.description: nextSince from the previous call (ms timestamp or ISO date). Omit on the first call.

name: trnch_heat
title: Read the Heat feed
